title: Umfuni Wenyaniso Oqinileyo
intro: Ngexesha eligutyungelwe kukungaqondi nokunqulwa koothixo bobuxoki, kwavela uhambo olukhulu lokholo. Lo mntu waphikisana nemigaqo yoluntu lwakhe, efuna uMdali Oyedwa Oyinyaniso ngokuqiniseka okungagungqiyo. Lungiselela ukutyhila ubuwena bomphefumlo onelifa eliqhubeka likhuthaza izigidi zabantu.
clues: Ndazibuza ngezidalwa zasezulwini, ndifuna iNkosi yokwenene edala nexhasa zonke izinto.
Ndayalelwa ukuba ndishiye ilizwe lam, ndihambe ndiye kwilizwe elisikelelwe ngu-Allah.
Ndizichasile izithixo zabantu bam, ndijongana nokungabi namsebenzi kwazo ngokuthe ngqo ngokuzaphula.
Ndaphoswa emlilweni ovuthayo ngabantu bam, kodwa kwaba mnandi kwaye kwaba noxolo kum ngomyalelo ka-Allah.
Ndavavanywa ngomyalelo wokuba ndinikele ngonyana wam wamazibulo endimthandayo, uvavanyo lokuzithoba ngokupheleleyo.
Mna, kunye nonyana wam, saphakamisa iziseko zeNdlu yokuqala yoNqulo eMhlabeni, indawo yokusabela yoluntu lonke.
arabic: قُلْنَا يَـٰنَارُ كُونِى بَرْدًۭا وَسَلَـٰمًا عَلَىٰٓ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ
verse: We [i.e., Allāh] said, "O fire, be coolness and safety upon Abraham." (21:69)
